skill1: Activates only when in Focusing status. Affects all allies. Focuses fire continuously.

caveats: ⚑ skill2 block 1 Bubble status durationSec=180 is a stand-in for "continuously" (fight length); the paired Damage Taken ▲5.05% is authored as a permanent (no-duration) boss debuff. If the engine's status window must outlast the fight, raise it.

⚑ skill2 block 2 (Explosive Bubble) is modeled as an ADDITIVE SECOND Damage Taken ▲5.05% stacking on top of block 1's, because the kit says "Removes Bubble" only (it never says it removes the Damage Taken debuff). If the real behaviour is a REPLACEMENT (net 5.05% total, not 10.10%), this over-credits ~5% team-wide damage for the rest of the fight — measure a popup pair before/after the 50th normal attack.

⚑ "Removes Bubble" is unmodeled: the engine has no status-removal primitive, so the Bubble window stays open after the explosive proc. Consequence: if the 50-hit trigger could re-arm (kit does not say it repeats — read as once-per-battle by the absence of "each time"), a same-status re-fire would be wrongly gated OPEN. Modeled as a single fire; verify whether it repeats every 50 normals.

⚑ skill2 block 3 trigger "every 1 sec only during Full Burst" is authored as interval sec=1 + fbGate inFb — the interval's first fire is at t=1s of battle-relative ticks, NOT 1s after FB entry, and the gate merely suppresses out-of-FB ticks. That yields ~10 fires per 10s FB window but the PHASE inside the window is a convention (worst case ±1 fire per FB). Pin from popup timing.

⚑ The two multi-hit lines (4× 63.36%, 10× 85%) are authored as SPLIT hits (N separate flatDamage effects) rather than one merged hit, per the sequential-attack reading of "Attacks sequentially N times". Split vs merge is damage-identical for a flat rider but differs for popup counting and for any per-hit core/crit roll — read popups to confirm N distinct numbers.

⚑ Both damage riders are authored crit:true / noRange:true / core-absent (no "core strike" wording) and take Full Burst by TIMING (noFb NOT set, per the default-ON rule). "Affects random enemy units" is single-target on a solo boss, so no target-count division is applied.

⚑ burst "Reloads 33.26% magazine(s)" is modeled as instantReload fraction=0.3326 (a fraction of MAX capacity) on all allies. If the game instead grants 33.26% of a magazine as a whole-magazine count (i.e. rounds up to a partial belt differently), the shot economy shifts slightly; the literal reading is a fractional refill.

⚑ Both teamAmmo thresholds (400 / 500) count TOTAL ally ammo expended and re-arm each time ("each time … reaches"); infinite-ammo shots do not consume. Cadence of these procs is therefore a function of the whole team's fire economy, not this unit's — expect high comp sensitivity.

⚑ Cadence tuple (SMG 120 ammo / 81 reloadFrames / normalAttackMultiplier 10.12) comes from the datamine and is unverified for this unit; the effective SMG rate is frame-quantized (60/ceil(60/nominal)). It gates the 50-normal-attack trigger's timing.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Little Mermaid (little-mermaid, SMG/Wind/Supporter/Burst I) is modeled as a team-wide damage/gauge support with two boss debuff layers and two multi-hit riders. S1: an FB-end team burst-CDR of 7.48s, an FB-enter team Attack Damage ▲4%/10s, and a team-ammo-400 gauge fill of 37%; the "Focusing status" line is unmodeled (a targeting/aim behaviour with no damage primitive — the sim has no aim state, and "focuses fire continuously" grants no stat). S2: a battle-start permanent Damage Taken ▲5.05% boss debuff paired with a named 'Bubble' targetStatus, a 50-normal-attack Explosive Bubble adding a second 5.05% plus a 3s stun (Bubble-gated via requiresTargetStatus), an in-FB 1s interval 4×63.36% rider, and a team-ammo-500 10×85% Bubble Barrage. Burst: team Attack Damage ▲10.13%/10s + a 33.26%-magazine reload, and a self ATK ▲17.28% of own ATK for 10s (authored casterAtkPct on a self target — the kit says "of the skill user's ATK", so it resolves flat, not as a self-scaling atkPct). Damage Taken ▲ is treated as a boss debuff benefiting the whole team, never a self buff; the stun and the reload are kept as real weapon-state/economy effects, not skipped as defensive.

flags.estimate: Additive second layer → 10.10% total Damage Taken ▲ after the 50th normal attack (vs 5.05% if it replaces)
flags.reasoning: The kit says "Removes Bubble" but never says it removes Bubble's Damage Taken ▲. Two same-stat same-caster-slot buffs may also collide under the engine's same-caster-slot overwrite rule, which would silently make it a replacement regardless of intent. Highest-leverage unknown in this kit: it is a team-wide multiplier for ~the whole fight.
flags.recipe: Record one fight; read a repeated ally popup value (a fixed-multiplier normal hit from a unit with no other changing buffs) immediately BEFORE and AFTER the 50th normal attack / the stun. Ratio ≈1.048 → additive (5.05→10.10); ratio ≈1.000 → replacement. Cross-check with a buffApply event trace filtered on stat 'damageTakenPct' value 5.05 with casterIdx===null && targetIdx===null (boss-held debuffs), counting live instances.

flags.estimate: Fires ONCE per battle at 50 landed normal attacks
flags.reasoning: Trigger-identity read: the two ammo lines say "each time … reaches", this one says "after landing 50 normal attacks" — the absence of the recurrence phrase is the discriminator. But the engine's hitCount trigger is inherently recurring (every `count` cumulative hits), so as authored it will RE-FIRE every 50 hits, and because "Removes Bubble" is unmodeled the requiresTargetStatus gate stays open for every re-fire — potentially stacking Damage Taken ▲ and the stun many times over a 180s fight.
flags.recipe: Count stun events in footage: exactly one 3s stun per fight → one-shot (add an everyN/one-shot guard or a resource gate). Multiple stuns ~every 50 rounds → the recurring encoding is correct as written. Same trace also settles the debuff-stacking question above.

flags.estimate: ~10 fires per 10s Full Burst window; first fire at the first battle-second tick that falls inside FB
flags.reasoning: The kit gives "every 1 sec only during Full Burst" — a recurring conditional with no anchor stated for whether the 1s clock starts at FB entry or runs globally. The engine's interval trigger is battle-anchored (first at t=sec), so the fbGate only suppresses out-of-FB ticks; a global clock and an FB-anchored clock can differ by up to one fire per window (≈63.36%×4 ATK per FB).
flags.recipe: Popup-count the 4-hit rider bursts inside one FB window from footage (expect 9 vs 10 vs 11 groups of 4) and time the first group relative to the FB banner frame. If FB-anchored, the first group lands ~1.0s after entry every window.

flags.field: skill2[2] / skill2[3] split-vs-merge (4× and 10× sequential hits)
flags.estimate: SPLIT — N independent flatDamage hits, each rolling crit at the caster's sheet rate
flags.reasoning: "Attacks sequentially N times" reads as N discrete hits, and sequential flavor implies per-hit resolution. Damage-neutral vs a single merged hit for a flat rider with uniform buffs, but NOT neutral for crit variance, popup counts, or any future per-hit core rate. Kit-silent, so ⚑ per the taxonomy.
flags.recipe: Read popups during a Full Burst: 4 distinct numbers per second (some orange = crit) → split; one number at ~4× magnitude → merge. Same read on the Bubble Barrage (10 numbers vs one ~10× number).

flags.estimate: FB major APPLIES by timing (noFb unset); NO core bucket (core absent); crit ENABLED; noRange true
flags.reasoning: Per the default rules: function-damage riders take Full Burst by landing timing (default ON, measured-only to disable), the +30% range bonus is universally off on riders, riders crit at the caster's rate, and they get no core unless the text says "core strike damage" — this kit says neither "core" nor any range/FB exemption. The in-FB rider is by definition always inside FB, so a wrong noFb here is a flat 1.5× error on that whole channel.
flags.recipe: Compare the in-FB rider popup magnitude against a same-frame normal-attack popup with known buffs: solve for whether the ×1.5 FB major is present. Requires the popup-reading pass, not derivable from prose.

flags.estimate: In a 5-unit comp, ~400 team rounds accrue in the opening ~10-20s and repeat every ~10-20s thereafter; both meters re-arm independently
flags.reasoning: "Each time the total ammo expended by allies reaches N" is explicitly recurring and team-scoped, so the proc count is a property of the COMP's aggregate fire economy (weapon types, reload uptime, unlimited-ammo windows that do not consume), not of this unit. Highly comp-sensitive: the 37% gauge fill can shift full-burst COUNTS, which is the measured-exact axis on graded comps.
flags.recipe: Run the harness fixture and count teamAmmo firings per fight via the event trace; cross-check FB count against a recorded fight for the same comp (FB count is the measured-exact instrument for gauge changes). No new footage needed if a labeled comp already exists — check docs/VALIDATION-INDEX.md first.

flags.estimate: fraction 0.3326 of MAX magazine, granted to all allies at burst cast
flags.reasoning: "Reloads 33.26% magazine(s)" is literally a fraction of a magazine; the schema's instantReload fraction is a fraction of max capacity, so the mapping is direct. Kit-silent on whether a partial refill rounds to whole rounds and on whether it can overfill a partially-spent belt. This is a shot-economy effect and therefore damage-bearing across the whole team.
flags.recipe: Ammo-counter read on any ally at the burst frame: count rounds restored vs that unit's max × 0.3326 (round up vs down vs truncate). The ammo counter measures the disputed quantity directly.

flags.estimate: 180s — the full fight length, standing in for "continuously"
flags.reasoning: targetStatus requires a durationSec, but the kit's Bubble is applied at enemy-appear and persists until the explosive proc removes it. 180s covers the scope-lock fight. Paired debuff authored with no durationSec (true permanent). The only risk is a fight longer than 180s or an engine that treats the status window strictly.
flags.recipe: None needed for scope-lock (180s fights); if fight length changes, raise the value. Confirm the gate stays satisfied by asserting the 50-hit block actually fires in the harness event trace.
